title: Multiwythe walls.
officialText:
The fire-resistance rating for walls or partitions consisting of two or more dissimilar wythes shall be permitted to be determined by the formula:
R = (R10.59 +R20.59 + ...+Rn0.59) 1.7 (Equation 7-11)
where:
R = The fire endurance of the assembly (hours).

R1, R2 and Rn = The fire endurance of the individual wythes (hours). Values for Rn0.59 for use in Equation 7-11 are given in Table 721.4.1(3).
